title: stAirCase IPC Protocol v1
description: JSON-Lines messages exchanged over the Unix Domain Socket between the Python runtime and the Go orchestrator.

Kind.description: Exhaustive enum of all message type discriminators.

auth.description: Python → Go: initial auth handshake carrying the one-time session token.

token.description: One-time bootstrap token generated by the orchestrator.

auth_ok.description: Go → Python: auth accepted; message loop may begin.

auth_failed.description: Go → Python: auth rejected; connection will be closed.

state_emit.description: Python → Go: node completion event; triggers SOC2 audit log entry and live monitor update.

active_agent.description: Name of the agent node that just completed.

input_tokens.description: LLM input tokens consumed in this step.

output_tokens.description: LLM output tokens produced in this step.

ProposedEdit.description: A single search-and-replace change the agent wants to make to a file.

file.description: Relative or absolute path of the file to edit.

search_block.description: Exact content to locate in the file.

replace_block.description: Content to replace the search_block with.

yield_request.description: Python → Go: HITL approval gate; execution pauses until yield_response is returned.

agent_name.description: Name of the agent requesting approval.

proposed_edits.description: File edits to be applied if approved.

reasoning_trace.description: Agent's chain-of-thought explaining the proposed action.

batch_id.description: Groups related yield requests into a single approval screen.

yield_response.description: Go → Python: operator or policy decision for the pending yield_request.

approved.description: True if the operator or policy approved the action.

feedback.description: Optional rejection reason or guidance for the agent.

secret_request.description: Python → Go: request to fetch a named secret from the encrypted store.

key_name.description: Name of the secret to retrieve. Must not be empty.

project_id.description: Optional project scope; if absent the global secret is returned.

secret_response.description: Go → Python: decrypted secret plaintext or error. Plaintext is delivered over the UDS, never via environment variables.

plaintext_value.description: Decrypted secret plaintext. Present on success.

heartbeat.description: Python → Go: keepalive ping sent at regular intervals.
